items.title: ISO 27001 certificate
items.text: Northwind Ledger is certified to ISO 27001:2022 by an accredited certification body; the certificate covers the production platform and support operations.

items.title: SOC 2 Type II report
items.text: A SOC 2 Type II report covering security, availability and confidentiality is issued every 12 months and shared under NDA.

items.title: Penetration test summary 2025
items.text: An independent penetration test of the web application and API was completed in June 2025 with no open critical findings.

items.title: Encryption standard
items.text: Data is encrypted in transit with TLS 1.2 or higher and at rest with AES-256; keys are managed in AWS KMS with yearly rotation.

items.title: Hosting and data residency
items.text: Production data is hosted in AWS eu-central-1 in Frankfurt with backups in AWS eu-west-1 in Dublin; no customer data is stored outside the European Union.

items.title: Subprocessor list
items.text: Subprocessors are AWS for hosting, Zendesk for support tickets and Anthropic for AI invoice coding; customers are notified 30 days before a new subprocessor is added.

items.title: Data processing agreement
items.text: Every contract includes a data processing agreement under Article 28 GDPR with the EU Standard Contractual Clauses where data leaves the EEA.

items.title: AI data usage statement
items.text: Customer data is not used to train AI models; prompts sent for AI invoice coding are not retained by the model provider beyond 30 days.

items.title: Incident response policy
items.text: Customers are notified of a personal data breach without undue delay and within 48 hours of confirmation.

items.title: Identity and access
items.text: Single sign-on supports SAML 2.0 with Microsoft Entra ID and Okta, SCIM provisioning, and enforced multi-factor authentication for all staff.

items.title: Backup and recovery
items.text: Backups run every 24 hours and are kept for 35 days; the recovery time objective is 8 hours and the recovery point objective is 24 hours.

items.title: Data retention after contract end (draft)
items.text: Customer data is deleted within 30 days after contract end unless a longer retention is required by law.
